The ~200 underlying per-operator feeds keep their own upstream terms; this record does not launder them and is NOT authority to fetch any agency feed directly.
geography: California, statewide -- every operator on Cal-ITP's nightly ingest list
time_coverage: current statewide snapshot; refreshed and republished monthly (CKAN accrualPeriodicity R/P1M)
schema_and_format: CSV keyed on (base64_url, stop_id), carrying stop_name, stop_lat, stop_lon and the usual GTFS stop attributes. ACQUIRED FOR ONE SPECIFIC HONESTY REASON: coordinates are what separates a real non-revenue MOVEMENT from a LAYOVER in place. A gap between two trips in the same block that begins and ends at the same stop is a vehicle standing still, not deadheading; without stop geometry the derivation would silently count both as deadhead and overstate it.
update_frequency: monthly (CKAN accrualPeriodicity R/P1M). source_checksum is null -- trust-on-first-use.
canonical_contract: themis.canonical.entities.DeadheadSegment.from_stop_ref / to_stop_ref (Program A, ADR-0047) -- source stop identifiers only. No canonical Stop entity exists in this repo, and this manifest does not invent one; the coordinates are used for the layover-vs-movement split and are not stored on any canonical row.

quality_tests.name: header_carries_stop_key_and_coordinates
quality_tests.description: the first line contains base64_url, stop_id, stop_lat and stop_lon -- the coordinates are the entire reason this file is held

quality_tests.name: coordinates_are_in_california
quality_tests.description: the large majority of parseable stop_lat/stop_lon fall inside a generous California bounding box, so a lat/lon column swap or a degrees/radians error would be caught before it silently zeroes every deadhead distance

acceptance_threshold: downloads over plain HTTPS with no credential, is CSV, > 1 MB, header contains base64_url, stop_id, stop_lat and stop_lon.
retention_and_deletion: retain: small (~20 MB) and required for the layover-vs-movement distinction that keeps the derived figure honest. Reproducible monthly.
